subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API integration architecture review — intro & scheduling

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo earlier this month. We'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on our Hosted API integration: SDK usage, streaming responses, and tool/function calling patterns. Goal is to walk our platform engineers through end-to-end integration and discuss any potential performance/latency concerns.

Attendees from our side: Alex Kim (platform lead), Priya N. (security), and one backend engineer (TBD).

Are you available next week for a 60 minute session? Our preferred windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-22 10:00–12:00
- Wed 2026-06-23 09:00–11:00

If those don't work, happy to propose alternatives. We may also ask for a short pre-read if you have a sample architecture/agenda.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Kim
Platform Lead, Acme Analytics
alex.kim@acme-analytics.com

Hi Alex —

Thanks — we'd be glad to run a technical architecture review. Suggested attendees from Redwood: myself (product lead for integrations), Lauren (solutions engineer, SDKs + streaming), and Rafael (platform eng, runtime/latency).

We can do a 60-minute deep-dive. From our side the best times (PDT) next week are:
- Tue 2026-06-22 11:00–12:00
- Wed 2026-06-23 09:30–10:30

If Tue 10–11 was your preference, we can also shift Rafael's schedule to make 10:30–11:30 work.

Agenda (draft) — happy to adjust:
1) 10m intros + goals
2) 20m Redwood Hosted API overview (SDKs, streaming, token/throughput expectations)
3) 20m Integration architecture walkthrough (prefix caching, KV cache behavior for conversational workloads, function/tool calling examples)
4) 10m Q&A + next steps/action items

I'll attach a short agenda and a lightweight pre-read with sample SDK call patterns. Please confirm preferred slot and I'll send a calendar invite with a Google Doc for notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
